name: Ableton - Wavetable growl bass
description: Reference checklist for an Ableton Wavetable dubstep growl: two wavetables, Env 2 scanning, mono sub, retriggered filter LFO, drive and a short reverb send. Not executable.

manual.instruction: Load two gnarly wavetables, for example Sapphire and Ruby. Blend them and lower the second oscillator's level so it adds texture instead of dominating.
manual.verify: The oscillator pair has a vocal, metallic character before filtering.
manual.why: Push Patterns layers two Wavetable tables and lowers the second's volume.

manual.instruction: Use Envelope 2 with an up-then-down shape and assign it to both oscillator positions. Adjust the matrix amounts until the scan is slow enough to hear as movement.
manual.verify: Both tables scan together and the patch has a deliberate vowel-like motion.
manual.why: Push Patterns assigns Envelope 2 to oscillator 1 and 2 positions and shapes the scan.

manual.instruction: Turn Poly off and use Mono. Turn on the sub oscillator. Set the filter LFO to retrigger, give it a slower attack and a 1/16 musical rate, then assign it to filter cutoff.
manual.verify: The bass is centered, has a clean sub, and the filter breathes in time.
manual.why: Push Patterns switches Wavetable to mono, enables the sub and uses a retriggered 1/16 filter LFO.

manual.instruction: Drive the oscillator into the filter for grit, then add a small reverb send. Keep the reverb short and low so the sub and transient stay tight.
manual.verify: The growl is aggressive but not washed out.
manual.why: Push Patterns drives Wavetable into the filter and adds a restrained reverb.

manual.instruction: Try a custom wavetable made from a recorded vowel or one-shot. Drag the sample into the wavetable slot and rescan it with the same modulation.
manual.verify: The patch becomes a unique table rather than a stock preset.
manual.why: Push Patterns demonstrates loading a user sample as a custom wavetable.

notes: Source: Push Patterns, 'How To Make DUBSTEP BASS Sounds with WAVETABLE In Ableton Live' (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nbmxDxKji9M). Transcript summary, not quotes. Reference-only because the engine cannot create or verify Wavetable patches.
